metadata.title: Raw Material Price Library for Piping Materials
metadata.note: Rates are indicative raw material input prices only. They are not finished pipe prices. Finished pipe price shall include conversion, forming, welding or piercing, heat treatment, testing, inspection, certification, wastage, freight, taxes and supplier margin.
metadata.year_logic: Use yearly_rate_inr_per_kg[PO Year].recommended for selected app year; 2026 is retained in rate_inr_per_kg for backward compatibility.
metadata.factor_note: factor_wrt_cs_by_year compares raw material recommended Rs/kg with Carbon Steel recommended Rs/kg for the same year.

metadata.title: Bolt and gasket manufacturing input price references
metadata.note: Observed supplier advertisements for manufacturing stock, not confirmed current quotations, certified finished component prices or market averages. The check date does not establish the effective date of a price. Stock form, size, condition, quantity, certification and commercial terms can change the price.
metadata.activation_note: Bolting observations marked budget_pricing_enabled with exact budget_grade_mappings supply default raw-stock defaults for their budget_year only. Gasket observations retain candidate/reference status, not approved stock status. The separately owner-enabled AUTO gasket budget policy may use exact candidates as estimating references with limitations recorded; Manual mode still requires suitability acceptance. Existing pipe recommended/yearly prices are unchanged. No procurement approval, engineering substitution, live-market update or finished-factor calibration is implied. Source-review and unsupported-construction safeguards remain in force.
metadata.conversion_basis_note: A bar, strip, foil or sheet already includes processing from primary feedstock. Future conversion factors must start from the listed stock condition to avoid counting that processing twice. Stud and nut stock costs may differ. Composite gaskets require constituent metal, filler and ring costs rather than one universal steel rate.
metadata.history_note: No historical yearly rates, recommended market rates, low/high ranges or grade-equivalence approvals have been inferred from these single advertised observations.
metadata.storage_note: Each observation is stored exactly once inside raw_material_price_library. Shared provenance, default status, currency, units, commercial unknowns and unset conversion factors apply to every component_stock_price_references record. SS304/304L observations attach to the existing 304/304L family; SS316 and SS316L observations attach to the existing shared 316/316L family while retaining distinct grade and stock details. AISI 4140 is category-level under High Strength Carbon / Low Alloy Steel, not equivalent to any existing pipe grade. Graphite and PTFE are in Non-Metallic Materials, whose empty children list intentionally supplies no active pipe-price mapping.

component_stock_price_references.listed_dimensions: Listed diameter range 10-300 mm; lengths 3 m, 6 m or cut; condition varies
component_stock_price_references.intended_use: Default low-carbon round-stock budget allowance for A307 A/B bolt or stud material only.
component_stock_price_references.limitations: SAE 1020 is a commercial carbon-stock allowance, not certification of ASTM A307 A/B chemistry/mechanical compliance. No nut grade is inferred from an A307 bolt designation. Finished headed bolts, coatings and grade-specific conversion factors remain unsupported.
component_stock_price_references.budget_nut_allowance_note: Owner-requested budget allowance for the explicit A307 B / A307 B BOM pair only: reuse this carbon-stock rate for the nut constituent, without certifying A307 as a nut standard or replacing it with an inferred nut grade. Confirm actual nut specification, heavy-hex dimensions and testing before procurement. Not a new supplier quotation.
component_stock_price_references.rate_selection_note: Supplier's advertised INR/kg rate; not a finished fastener price or historical-year rate. Tax and freight not confirmed.

Impact testing, heat treatment, certification and generic conversion factor require confirmation for procurement; no new market rate was collected.
